name: Cursor CLI (cursor-agent)
role: opt-in executor. Not selected unless --backend cursor is passed, or "cursor" is listed in routing.default_order
binary_resolution: OPENSWARM_CURSOR_BIN, else cursor-agent on PATH, else ~/.local/bin/cursor-agent
quota_source: none (unknown). Token usage is read from the stream-json result event after the run, not used for routing
streaming_events: stream-json lines; the result event carries the final text and usage
